items.stem: Before trusting a micrometer reading, a technician should first confirm the instrument is:

options.text: Within its calibration due date and traceable
options.rationale: Correct: a gauge must be in calibration to give trustworthy readings.
Cost does not determine measurement validity.
Storage location does not confirm accuracy.
Colour is irrelevant to measurement validity.

items.explanation: Correct: a gauge must be in calibration to give trustworthy readings.

items.stem: An acceptance sampling plan lets a technician:

options.text: Decide whether to accept or reject a lot from a sample
options.rationale: Correct: sampling plans base a lot decision on a defined sample.

options.text: Guarantee zero defects in the lot
options.rationale: Sampling accepts some risk; it does not guarantee zero defects.
